ruling.recommended_action: Refund $10.36 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour distance; note the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file (no account flag — no prior upheld route dispute).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:12–09:26 adding 7.35 km (1333 m off the optimal route). Driver's congestion claim fails RD-4: the only traffic support is a band-2 speed record on AYE [F9] whose window 08:49–09:12 ends when the deviation begins, and band 2 is corroborative only (RD-4(b)); no incident exists on the route [F12], so RD-4(a) is unmet and RD-4(c) applies. No prior rider consent (no chat [F7]) → RD-5 does not exempt.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's traffic/flooding justification for the deviation is unsupported: the AYE band-2 record [F9] expires at 09:12 as the detour starts, band 2 is corroborative only (RD-4(b)), and no incident was recorded on the route [F12] (RD-4(a)). Heavy rain [F13] is not a listed reasonable cause.
The $10.68 billed excess covers 7.6 km including 0.25 km of map-matching residue; RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's distance (7.35 km → $10.36), not the full fare difference.
